policy_metadata.policy_title: Cell and Gene Therapy (CGT) Access Model

sections.heading: Overview
content: This policy outlines Humana’s billing requirements and reimbursement for services rendered as part of the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) Cell and Gene Therapy (CGT) Access Model.

sections.heading: Kentucky Medicaid Payment Policy
content: In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements. As used in this policy, x represents any appropriate frequency code, which is the final digit of the type of bill (TOB) code. Providers must report CGT services consistent with applicable guidance from the Kentucky Department for Medicaid Services. This includes that model drugs rendered as part of the CGT Access Model must be reported on paper UB-04 claim forms. Providers may not claim discounts under the 340B Drug Pricing Program when purchasing model drugs rendered as part of the CGT Access Model. Humana denies model drugs reported with modifier TB or modifier UD . Humana reimburses for model drugs rendered as part of the CGT Access Model separately from the inpatient hospital Diagnosis Related Group (DRG) payment. To facilitate such payment, the facility should report the model drug on a UB-04 claim form with TOB 13x.

sections.heading: Definition of Italicized Terms
content: • Modifier TB : Drug or biological acquired with 340B Drug Pricing Program discount • Modifier UD : Physician administered drug purchased through the 340B Drug Pricing Program
